rows.en:
(On a rare day off, just wandering around
isn't half bad.)

Huh, \p-kun...!
What are you doing here?
Oh, Ranka!
What about you, Ranka? What are you doing here...?

I had a little free time,
so I came shopping~
I see. You seem busy.

Hey, \p-kun,
if you've got time, wanna chat?
Oh, it's almost time!
Okay. Hang in there, Ranka.

(A rare day off...
Some window shopping isn't bad at all.)

Huh, \p-chan...!
What are you doing here?
Huh? Ranka-chan!

What about you, Ranka-chan?
What are you doing here...?
I see. You seem busy.

Hey, \p-chan~
If you've got time, wanna chat?
Sure, sounds good~

Is it that time already?!
Good luck, Ranka-chan.

Huh, \p-kun...!
We meet again!

Oh, Ranka!
Did you sneak out of work again?

I did not!
I was just getting a change of pace
in my free time!
rows.notes: Ranka, male scene (kibun tenkan as an ordinary phrase, not the Outing command).

rows.en: I was only kidding, so don't get so mad.
Hmph!

Hey, if you've got time,
let's chat again today, okay?

Oh, look at the time!
See you, \p-kun!
Take care, Ranka.
I'm off!
(On a rare day off, window shopping is the best.)

Huh, \p-chan...!
We meet again!

Yeah, what a coincidence...
Are you off today?
I had some free time, so I'm doing some shopping.
Busy as ever, huh.
Hey, \p-chan~
rows.notes: Ranka, female scene; continues in c13556.

rows.en: If you've got time today too, wanna chat?
Of cour~se.

(Maybe I'll try going up to the roof
after school today.)
Oh, \p-kun.
Funny seeing you up here. What were you doing?

Mm~, nothing in particular?
If I had to say, I was looking at the sky,
I guess?
Hmm. Then I'll look at the sky too.
Has work calmed down lately?

You push yourself way too hard, Ranka,
so make sure you rest when you can.
I'm not pushing myself, but... okay...
...Thanks for worrying about me!
Oh, \p-chan!

Funny running into you up here.
What were you doing?
I see. Then I'll look at the sky too.

You push yourself way too hard, Ranka-chan,
so you've got to rest when you can, okay?
(Maybe I'll go up to the roof again today.)
Oh, \p-kun!

We meet again.
Is this your new favorite spot?

Is it, I wonder?
I just felt like seeing the sky again, so I came.
I see... Then I'll look at the sky too.
Oh, look at the time!
Work again?
Yeah, a meeting about a concert.
rows.notes: x2, Ranka; raibu = concert per glossary.

rows.en: Go get 'em.
Oh~, \p-chan!

We meet again.
Is the roof your new favorite spot?
I see... Then I'll look at the sky too.
I know it's tough, but do your best.

uncertain: c13543: kibun tenkan here is Ranka's ordinary 'change of pace' during free time from work, not the Outing schedule command.
